tickets.title: Coordinate call with Velvet Acorn Custody

tickets.title: Complete household profile update
tickets.text: Refresh the Lanternmoss household profile using client-provided updates and recent planning notes. Confirm household members, contact preferences, employment status, dependents, trusted contacts, insurance context, estate document status, and any major life changes that may affect planning recommendations. Update the trusted contact list to include Ruth Lanternmoss and adjust the successor fiduciary role to Iris Lanternmoss. Ensure the profile reflects Helena Lanternmoss’s current mobile number and removes the prior work phone number.

subTasks.title: Collect profile change information
subTasks.text: Request or compile updates for household members, addresses, contact preferences, employment, dependents, and major recent or expected life events.

subTasks.title: Update planning assumptions
subTasks.text: Revise income, savings, spending, retirement timing, education funding, and family support assumptions in the planning record as applicable.

subTasks.title: Identify advice impacts
subTasks.text: Flag changes that may affect tax planning, risk management, estate coordination, cash flow, or investment allocation recommendations.

subTasks.title: Confirm profile completion
subTasks.text: Review the updated profile for consistency and note any remaining open questions for the next client conversation.

tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is due November 17, 2023.

tickets.title: Follow up on policy renewal details
tickets.text: Contact Helena Lanternmoss or Pocket Lantern Insurance to confirm renewal status, premium change, coverage changes, beneficiary updates needed, and any action required before the renewal window closes. Record received documents and route planning questions to the advisor. Compare the identity theft endorsement renewal options to identify a plan with a higher reimbursement cap that meets Helena’s expectations.
tickets.evidence: the coverage choice remains unresolved while the account security issue is being reviewed, with follow-up needed by November 22, 2023.
